title: Gods of the Ghats
desc: A short documentary on life in the Sahyadris, following the atmosphere, species, and sacred ecology of the Western Ghats.

title: Great Indian Bustard: Courtship on the Last Grasslands
desc: A field film on the Great Indian Bustard's courtship display in Rajasthan, and the grassland stewardship needed for the species to survive.

title: The 10-Gram Traveller
desc: A Red-breasted Flycatcher links continents, winter refuge, Mukundara Hills and the Aravalli belt in one tiny migratory body.

title: Desert Fox Family: Survival in Open Country
desc: A field documentary following a desert fox family through heat, predators and the daily pressures of India's arid landscapes.

title: Birding Ethics at Nalsarovar
desc: A grounded look at guiding practices in sensitive wetlands, and why responsible birding standards matter.

title: Little Rann of Kutch: Wetland and Salt Desert Lives
desc: Flamingos, raptors, pelicans and Hoopoe-Lark across a landscape where wetlands and dry open country meet.
